bio.text: Chuck Martin has served in the Georgia House of Representatives since 2003, representing District 49 in North Fulton County, and chairs the Higher Education Committee.
Before the legislature, Martin served on the Alpharetta City Council from 1993 to 1995 and as Alpharetta's mayor until 2002.
Martin was born and raised in Alpharetta, earned a B.B.A. in management science from the University of Georgia in 1983, and is a director with Ryan, LLC.
